subject: general
question: If the mean of 22, 25, 27, 24 and x is 26, then the value of x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume the **mean** is 26.

Find **deviations** from 26: (22−26) = −4, (25−26) = −1, (27−26) = +1, (24−26) = −2.

Net **deviation** of known numbers = −4 − 1 + 1 − 2 = −6.

To balance the **mean** at 26, the deviation of **x** must be +6.

Value of **x** = Mean + Required Deviation = 26 + 6 = 32.

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Observations = 22, 25, 27, 24, x | Total count (n) = 5 | Mean = 26.

**Formula:** Mean = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f18518d25fda746f687d3225b2194cb9df6c4faec3b63e548f524b870404d67e.png] 

⇒ Sum of observations = (22 + 25 + 27 + 24 + x)

⇒ Sum = 98 + x

⇒ Mean = Sum ÷ n

⇒ 26 = (98 + x) ÷ 5

⇒ 26 × 5 = 98 + x

⇒ 130 = 98 + x

⇒ x = 130 − 98

⇒ x = 32

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

The **average** or **mean** is the sum of all values divided by the total count: Mean = ∑X ÷ N.

Property of Deviations

The algebraic sum of **deviations** of a set of observations from their **arithmetic mean** is always **zero**.

Effect of Change in Origin

If a **constant k** is added to every observation in a data set, the **new mean** will be (Original Mean + k).</p
